top_signal.title: My only client hasn’t paid me in six months, and I’m scared my business is going to fall apart. How do I get through this?
top_signal.summary: Posting from a throwaway because I really don’t want this getting back to anyone involved.   I started my own content studio, and right now, I have one client. I initially came on board to manage his LinkedIn presence and ghostwrite a book for him. Over time, the scope kept expanding. I found myself handling Instagram content, planning content strategies, coordinating shoots, managing execution, and essentially becoming the person responsible for making sure everything happened.   The thing is, he knew social media management wasn’t really my area of expertise when I started taking it on. But I genuinely liked working with him, believed in what he was building, and wanted to help. So I kept saying yes, learning things as I went, and taking on more than I probably should have.   Here’s the problem:  I haven’t been paid a single penny in six months.    I understand that he’s going through financial difficulties, and I’ve tried to be patient because I genuinely care about him and the work we’re doing. But I feel like my willingness to accommodate his situation has gradually turned into an expectation that I’ll keep showing up and getting things done, regardless of whether I’m being paid.   I’m struggling with that, especially because this isn’t just about me anymore.   I have three people working with me, and I have salaries to pay.
